name: Systems Programming, Databases & Backend Engineering
stats: TCP stack · B+tree database engine with WAL · container orchestrator · CPU scheduler simulator
content: Advaith builds systems from scratch to understand them: a TCP stack that survives 30% packet loss, a database engine with a B+tree index and crash-safe write-ahead log, a mini container orchestrator that reschedules pods after node death, and a CPU scheduler simulator tested on 1,500 workloads. Day to day he works in Python, TypeScript/Node.js, PostgreSQL, Docker and Linux.
